name: openwiki
description: OpenWiki is a CLI that writes and maintains agent documentation for your codebase.

capability_evidence.remote-control: ongs to multiple workspaces without an active selection, search returns workspacerequired and the agent asks which workspace to use.
capability_evidence.model-routing: MPATIBLEUSERESPONSESAPI=true is also set, the effort is sent through the Responses API reasoning field.
capability_evidence.session-persistence: yourself, for example from CI so a run's thread can be found from the commit that triggered it.
capability_evidence.agent-runtime: ur code, your agents, and you.
capability_evidence.cross-agent-support: Mentions Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor

friction.note_en: Some setup. install via global npm install; needs npm install/build; configure environment variables, API key configuration
friction.note_zh: 需要一些配置。可通过 global npm install 安装；需要 npm install/build；需配置 environment variables、API key configuration

analysis.summary_en: OpenWiki turns your codebase and knowledge sources into a linked Markdown wiki that you own.
highlights: More coding-agent integrations: Oh My Pi, Antigravity, IBM Bob / Bob Shell, and Kiro join Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot and Cursor. Connect your agent →
index.md and log.md are reserved documents rather than concepts. The root index declares okf_version: "0.2".
notion targets the hosted Notion MCP server, so authenticate through Notion OAuth rather than pasting a token.
custom-mcp connects to any configured HTTP or stdio MCP server and permits only explicitly safe, read-only tools.
